summary: The change raises the auto-approve DTI ceiling from 40% to 43% across Policy.java, the unit test, and the approved parameter in policy-params.json, and the CI run on the final commit confirms all 124 tests (including the exhaustive CRD-1 control test) pass. However, policy-params.json resides under a protected path (controls/mortgage/*), which triggers CHG-6 requiring a control_owner approval from someone outside the author's team.
